title: Combobox
purpose: Help a user enter or select a value through an editable text field with a related popup of suggestions when a simpler native choice control does not satisfy the task.

selection_gate.question: Does this task need a custom editable combobox, or can a simpler native control satisfy it?

prefer_when: valid values are closed and known
custom text filtering is not required
select.benefit: browser and operating system own most semantics, keyboard and mobile interaction

consider_when: target browser and assistive-technology support has been tested
datalist.caveat: datalist has current support, styling and accessibility limitations and is not a universal shortcut

justify_when: suggestions are dynamically filtered or loaded from the query
active suggestion state must be controlled
free-text versus restricted-value policy must be explicit
popup presentation needs controlled listbox semantics

selection_gate.rule: Prefer the simplest control that satisfies the real value and interaction contract. Visual customization alone is not sufficient justification for a custom combobox.

composition.role: editable value and DOM focus owner

query.meaning: the current text in the input

popup_open.meaning: whether the suggestion popup is visible

active_option.meaning: the suggestion currently navigated in the popup; it may carry aria-selected=true and be referenced by aria-activedescendant while still not being the committed combobox value

selected_value.meaning: the value explicitly committed into the combobox value model according to the variant contract; distinct from popup option selection/highlight

filtered_options.meaning: the candidate set derived from the current query

value_policy.meaning: whether arbitrary text is valid or a listed value must be committed

invariants: changing query may clear a previously committed selected_value when the text no longer represents it
closing the popup does not by itself commit the active option
selected_value changes only through an explicit commit path defined by the variant

filtering.source: variant-defined local or remote candidate set
filtering.rule: query changes recompute candidate visibility without implicitly selecting the first option

popup.opens_when: variant rule says suggestions are available for the current query or the user explicitly invokes them
closes_on: focus leaving the complete combobox widget where appropriate
popup.no_results: must be distinguishable from a closed popup

keyboard.text_editing: preserve native single-line text editing behavior; do not intercept keys such as Home/End merely to emulate a select-only widget
keyboard.arrow_down: when suggestions are available, move active_option forward and keep DOM focus on input
keyboard.arrow_up: move active_option backward and keep DOM focus on input
keyboard.enter: commit active_option when one exists; otherwise follow the variant's normal input/form behavior
keyboard.escape: close the popup without committing active_option
keyboard.tab: remain normal page focus navigation; do not require Tab to choose a suggestion

focus.dom_focus: remains on editable input while navigating a listbox popup
focus.active_descendant: input aria-activedescendant identifies active option while one exists
focus.visibility: scroll active option into view when keyboard navigation changes it

behavior.pointer: pointer activation of an option commits that option without making hover a required path

commit.free_text: listed option may be committed, but unlisted text remains valid when the task allows it
commit.restricted: only an explicitly committed listed option is a valid selected_value

layout.input_and_popup: popup visually belongs to the input and does not alter surrounding document geometry unnecessarily
layout.popup_width: may follow input or content needs
layout.rich_options: secondary descriptive text may appear, but each option remains one selectable value

visual.preserve: clear distinction among input focus, active option, committed value feedback and disabled/empty states

accessibility.aria_activedescendant: present only while an active option exists
accessibility.popup_selection: The active listbox option may use aria-selected=true as the popup selection/focus indication. This does not by itself mean the combobox selected_value has been committed.

performance.local_filtering: avoid unnecessary work for small static sets
performance.remote_suggestions: out of scope for reference implementation; production integrations should debounce/cancel stale requests and expose loading/error state without changing the core state contract

constraints: Do not build a custom combobox merely to restyle a closed native select.
Do not treat active_option as selected_value before an explicit commit.
Do not move DOM focus into a listbox option in the documented editable-listbox variant.
Do not intercept native text-editing keys unnecessarily.
Do not require hover to reveal or choose suggestions.
Do not use interactive descendants such as buttons or links inside a listbox option in the Rich Suggestions variant.
Do not silently accept arbitrary text in a restricted-value combobox.
Do not silently restrict free text when the documented value policy allows arbitrary input.
Do not allow aria-activedescendant to reference a missing or hidden option.
Do not leave a keyboard-active option scrolled out of view.
Do not confuse aria-selected on the active popup option with the committed combobox selected_value.

must_preserve: selection gate outcome when pattern choice is open

agent_contract.instruction: If the control type is still a design decision, evaluate selection_gate before building a custom combobox. When a combobox is justified, reconstruct from this Build DNA rather than copying reference HTML. Keep query, active option and selected value as distinct states and ask for missing value-policy decisions instead of inventing them.
agent_contract.when_conflicting: Purpose, constraints, behavior, state contract and accessibility override visual resemblance.
agent_contract.output_expectation: Production-appropriate combobox code for the target stack plus any explicit unresolved value, filtering or commit decisions.

request_examples.intent: Decide whether select, datalist or custom combobox fits the task.
request_examples.prompt: Prüfe zuerst anhand des Selection Gate, ob mein Feld ein natives select, datalist oder eine echte Combobox braucht. Baue erst danach.

request_examples.intent: Build the documented editable manual-selection combobox.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir eine Combobox nach https://blame76.github.io/how-to-web/elements/interactive/combobox/ und nutze die Build DNA als Rekonstruktionsvertrag.

request_examples.intent: Build suggestions where arbitrary text stays valid.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir die Variante "Free Text Suggestions". Vorschläge helfen, aber freie Eingabe bleibt gültig.

request_examples.intent: Build filtering where a listed value must be committed.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir die Variante "Restricted Selection". Nur explizit ausgewählte Listenwerte sind gültig.

request_examples.intent: Build listbox suggestions with secondary descriptive metadata.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir die Variante "Rich Suggestions". Optionen dürfen sekundäre Information zeigen, bleiben aber je eine einzelne auswählbare Option ohne interaktive Kinder.

request_examples.intent: Adapt the Combobox contract to an existing project.
request_examples.prompt: Übertrage die how-to-web Combobox in mein Projekt. Bewahre State-, Value-, Keyboard- und Accessibility-Vertrag und nutze meine vorhandenen Tokens und Komponenten.

acceptance: Pattern choice is justified against select and datalist when that choice is still open.
Query, active option and selected value are observable as distinct states in implementation logic.
Input retains DOM focus while listbox options are navigated.
aria-expanded matches popup visibility and aria-controls references the popup.
aria-activedescendant references only the current visible active option and is removed when none is active.
Arrow navigation keeps the active option visible.
Enter commits only the active option; Escape closes without committing it.
Tab remains normal page focus navigation.
Native text editing behavior remains intact.
Free-text and restricted variants enforce their documented value policies.
The component remains usable at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.

examples.note: Manual list autocomplete where arbitrary text remains valid.
Filtered known-value set where a list option must be explicitly committed.
Listbox options with secondary descriptive metadata but no interactive descendants.
